note: Same defect one nesting level deeper: the pair value is an inline Array whose one item is an inline Object with an unterminated quoted key. The unterminated `"` swallows everything to end-of-line, including both the inner `}` and the outer `]`, so neither compound closes -- UnterminatedInlineCompound, not MalformedInlineCompound (requires an already-closed compound) and not UnterminatedQuotedKey (Sec 6.16 excludes inline-pair positions), regardless of nesting depth.
